changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM review_job WHERE config_snapshot -> 'schemaVersion' = '8'::jsonb AND config_snapshot -> 'allowInternet' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb

changeSet.comment: Sandbox network access is enforced by Kubernetes policy. Remove the unused false flag from v8 snapshots in every job state; older frozen formats retain their original meaning.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE review_job SET config_snapshot = (config_snapshot - 'allowInternet') || '{"schemaVersion":9}'::jsonb WHERE config_snapshot -> 'schemaVersion' = '8'::jsonb

rollback.stop: Stop every role and restore the database backup taken before this upgrade. The previous runtime cannot read the promoted configuration snapshots.
